_meta.about: The one list of product categories. The API validates Product.category against these keys, the admin builds its category dropdown from GET /api/categories, and the web build renders the homepage sections, footer links and /menu from it.
_meta.keys: key is what is stored in Product.category. Renaming or removing a key orphans every product that uses it, so move those products first.
_meta.order: Array order is the homepage and admin order. menu.order is the order on the printable /menu card.
